board: CJMCU-75 LM75A temperature sensor module (purple, 5-pin header VCC, GND, SDA, SCL, OS)
reason: Check PASS on esp32 and pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). Temp register 0x00 is modelled bit-exact as an 11-bit two's complement value in bits 15-5 at 0.125 C (signed, shift 5), and the driver decodes it per the datasheet section 7.4.3; Conf/Thyst/Tos hold their power-up values 0x00/0x4B00/0x5000.
breakoutPinoutSource: Photo of the CJMCU-75 top silkscreen (github.com/hpaluch/i2c-cjmcu-75 assets/cjmcu-75-top.jpg): header VCC, GND, SDA, SCL, OS; the same repo's traced schematic shows A0-A2 as open solder pads between VCC and GND, 10k pull-ups on SDA/SCL, 200k pull-up and LED on OS
